INDEPENDENT REVIEW — machine register refused.

mote candidate review approve on cand-7JCB81PD47BGRFXY4VP3NS9VTW failed: this actor is not a named reviewer. The live named set is codex-storymodel4s-astro-docs-review and codex-storymodel4s-astro-science-review. I am not substituting into those roles.

APPROVE cand-7JCB81PD47BGRFXY4VP3NS9VTW at exact de9265cf584f2b27a1e45014549f279798c68792, docs-site only. I read the commit tree and the named pages. No edits, landing, or close.

Sixty-second journey: landing states the job, one WOG route table, and that the result stays conditional on chosen segmentation and proposition analysis; a research product records the policy or receipt and retains alternatives.

Code Red qualification: represent-recall names RecallSegmenter.segment as a reproducible heuristic baseline and says a terminal research result needs a named segmentation policy or receipt plus retained segmentation and interpretation alternatives. align-and-interpret repeats that in the first scientific paragraph.

Residual, not a block: getting-started and summarize-recall publish the same WOG numbers as workflow shape and say they are conditional on the heuristic/baseline segmentation, but they do not restate named-policy-plus-alternatives in their own body. Those pages point at represent-recall and align-and-interpret for the full claim. I would not treat those two pages as a terminal scientific publication on their own.

Prose is lucid. I did not rerun npm verify or the browser court.
